summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of MarketMindAI new features. All 35 backend tests PASSED. 2 bugs found and fixed. Frontend UI/integration verified for all 6 critical flows.

minor.issue: AI compare_tools() in ai_service.py didn't strip markdown code blocks (```json) before JSON parsing, causing raw JSON to appear in the AI Summary section. FIXED: Added code block stripping (same pattern as recommend_tools).
Response object missing 'url' field for tool recommendations, causing Visit Tool button not to appear in frontend. FIXED: Added 'url': tool.url to both AI and fallback response in ai_blog_routes.py

ui_bugs.issue: Before fix: AI Summary section showed raw JSON response text when JSON parsing failed (code blocks). Fixed via backend code block stripping.
Before fix: 'Visit Tool' button was not appearing for recommendation cards (missing url field from API). Fixed.

issues: Save Draft and Publish buttons use id= not data-testid= attributes. Minor testability issue. Buttons work correctly.
SuperAdmin dashboard loading fails with IP whitelist restriction (expected in preview env - 403 returned for IP not in whitelist). This is a security feature, not a bug.

action_items: DONE: Fixed ai_blog_routes.py - Added 'url' field to both AI and fallback tool recommendation responses
DONE: Fixed ai_service.py compare_tools() - Added markdown code block stripping before JSON parsing
Consider adding data-testid attributes to create.astro buttons (save-draft-btn, publish-btn) for better testability
404 errors for tool logo_url images - data quality issue (missing/broken image URLs in seeded tools)
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.py: generate_blog_content() and generate_seo_content() also missing markdown code block stripping - only recommend_tools had it before this fix
compare.astro: Tool search works via description match also - this is working correctly
blogs/[slug].astro: Like/Bookmark handlers check localStorage('auth_token') specifically; login.astro stores both 'auth_token' and 'token' for compatibility - consistent
user/blogs/create.astro getApiBaseUrl() lacks 'stage-preview.emergentagent.com' check that blogs/[slug].astro has - minor inconsistency
Recommend page still uses alert() in addToCompare function instead of toast notification (inconsistent with fix mentioned in session notes)
updated_files: /app/backend/ai_service.py (fixed compare_tools JSON parsing with code block stripping)

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all main flows working, minor issues noted)

seed_data_creation: Test blogs created (cleaned up after tests). SuperAdmin user existed in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL has seeded data (388+ blogs, 100+ tools). Key test slugs: EXISTING_BLOG_SLUG=affiliate-program-ai-matching, EXISTING_TOOL_SLUG=macaify, EXISTING_TOOL_ID=825d85ee-be5a-42cd-80e1-61ed9f0f5ed6. SuperAdmin IP whitelist 403 on /api/superadmin/* is expected in preview env. All core features working: blog create (tags as array), blog publish, like/bookmark toggles, user bookmarks, AI recommendations (Visit Tool btn fixed), AI comparison (winner banner + tool analysis cards fixed). Compare page search uses both name AND description filtering.

bug1_recommendations_missing_url.root_cause: In ai_blog_routes.py ai_recommend_tools(), the recommendations dict was manually constructed but 'url' (tool.url) was accidentally omitted from both the AI path (lines 363-376) and the fallback path (lines 405-418)
bug1_recommendations_missing_url.impact: Visit Tool button in recommend.astro is conditionally rendered: ${tool.url ? 'Visit Tool' : ''}, so no Visit Tool buttons appeared
bug1_recommendations_missing_url.fix: Added 'url': tool.url to both recommendation dict constructions

bug2_compare_raw_json.root_cause: ai_service.py compare_tools() used json.loads(response_content) directly without stripping markdown code blocks (```json...```). recommend_tools() had this stripping but compare_tools() did not.
bug2_compare_raw_json.impact: JSON parsing failed when AI returned code blocks, fallback was used with raw response_content as summary, resulting in raw JSON text displayed in AI Summary section
bug2_compare_raw_json.fix: Added same code block stripping pattern as recommend_tools(): clean up if '```json' or '```' in response
